page.overview:
What is Seven Extremes Mountain?

Seven Extremes Mountain is an eight hundred mile long mountain range covered entirely in thousands of persimmon trees. When the persimmons fall of the trees and rot each year, they completely fill the valley. Heat and frost combine the rotting pulp into a stinking mass that locals have nicknamed Slimy Feces Alley.
